title: 3 Days in Nosara, Costa Rica: Surf, Sun & Squad Goals
description: Your personalized Nosara group itinerary with surf spots, restaurants, group activities, and local tips.

days.title: Arrive, Surf & Sunset Feast
days.description: Land in Liberia, cruise to Nosara, hit the waves, and kick off the trip with a legendary sunset dinner on the cliffs. The crew energy starts here.

activities.name: Land at Liberia & Drive to Nosara
activities.description: Fly into Liberia (LIR) — it's a scenic 2.5-hour drive south through Nicoya Peninsula. Pick up your rental 4x4s at the airport (book Vamos Rent-A-Car or Adobe — they're reliable and have the real 4x4s you'll need). The drive is gorgeous: rolling hills, roadside fruit stands, howler monkeys in the trees. Once in Nosara, check into your accommodation and grab a quick bite.
tips: For groups of 5+, rent a private house or villa instead of hotel rooms — way more fun and often cheaper per person. Check Vrbo/Airbnb for properties with pools near Playa Guiones.

activities.name: Group Surf Lesson at Playa Guiones
activities.description: Playa Guiones is a 7km white-sand beach with consistent, forgiving waves — arguably the best learn-to-surf beach in Central America. The sandy bottom means soft wipeouts, and February brings clean 3–5 foot swells. Book a group lesson with Safari Surf School or Nosara Surf Academy — they handle groups of 5+ easily and the shared stoke of everyone catching their first wave together is unbeatable.
details: 📍 Playa Guiones — 7km beach break, sandy bottom
🏄 Group lesson: ~$55–75 USD/pp (2 hrs, board + instructor)

activities.time: 🌙 Evening — Sunset Dinner on the Cliffs
activities.name: La Luna Bar & Grill at Playa Pelada
activities.description: This is the move for night one. Drive 5 minutes to Playa Pelada — Nosara's smaller, rockier sunset beach — and grab a table at La Luna, perched right on the cliffs. The views are staggering: the Pacific stretching to infinity, the sky turning electric orange. Order rounds of guaro sours (Costa Rica's national spirit), fresh ceviche, and grilled mahi-mahi. Big tables on the terrace seat groups easily. Get there by 4:30pm to snag a prime spot.

days.title: Jungle Adventures, Yoga & Beach Bar Night
days.description: Your full day in paradise — split the group for morning adventures (surf vs. yoga vs. jungle), reconvene for a long lunch, then close it out at Nosara's best beach bars.

activities.name: Option A: Horseback Riding Through the Jungle
activities.description: Book the morning ride with Boca Nosara Tours — a 2.5-hour horseback tour that winds through dense jungle, crosses a river, and emerges onto a deserted stretch of beach. No experience needed. The horses are calm and the views are cinematic. Perfect for the non-surfers in the group. For the surfers in the crew — wake up at 5:30am and paddle out for dawn patrol. The morning glass-off at Guiones is magical: empty lineup, warm water, sunrise over the jungle behind you. Rent boards from the beach shacks ($15–20/day) or use your boards from yesterday's lesson.
details: 📍 Playa Guiones — south end for intermediates
📍 Bodhi Tree Yoga Resort — Guiones hilltop
tips: This is where groups shine — split up for the morning based on interests, then reconvene for lunch. Everyone comes back with different stories. Way better than forcing the whole crew into one activity.

activities.name: Extended Lunch at Organico
activities.description: The whole crew reconvenes at Organico, Nosara's beloved organic market and café. This is the social hub of town — communal tables, incredible Buddha bowls, fresh juices, and the best smoothies you've ever had. Browse their shop for local chocolate, kombucha, and natural products. Then walk over to Playa Guiones for a lazy group beach session — bodysurf, toss a frisbee, nap in the sand.

activities.name: Dinner at Il Basilico, Then Kaya Sol
activities.description: Tonight is the splurge night. Il Basilico is Nosara's best upscale restaurant — an open-air Italian spot in the jungle with fairy lights, candles, and handmade pasta that'll ruin Italian food for you forever. The lobster linguine and fresh tuna tartare are outstanding. Book a big table in advance — this place fills up in February. After dinner, walk over to Kaya Sol for the nightlife scene. It's an open-air surf bar with communal tables, craft beer from Treintaycinco Brewing, and DJs or live music depending on the night. This is where Nosara's social energy concentrates after dark.

days.title: Dawn Patrol & Farewell Brunch
days.description: Your last morning — one final sunrise surf, a long group brunch, tide pools at Pelada, and the drive back with sandy feet and full hearts.

activities.name: One Last Ride at Guiones
activities.description: Set the alarm for 5:30am — the whole crew paddles out for dawn patrol. The sunrise over the jungle, the empty lineup, the warm water, the dolphins that sometimes cruise by at dawn. This is the memory that'll have everyone texting "when are we going back?" for months. Even the non-surfers should come down to the beach to watch — it's that beautiful. After surfing, anyone who wants a mellower last morning can walk to Playa Pelada's north end at low tide. The rocky outcrops reveal incredible tide pools full of sea stars, crabs, and small fish. There's a blowhole in the rocks that shoots spray 20 feet high when the swell is right.
details: 📍 Playa Pelada — tide pools at the north rocks

activities.name: Group Brunch at Al Chile Viola
activities.description: The crew's final meal together. Al Chile Viola is a lively beachside spot with big tables, great ceviche, fish burritos with mango salsa, and killer margaritas. Order a round of micheladas, swap stories from the trip, and toast to Nosara. This is the restaurant with the best group energy — terrace seating, good music, and the kind of vibe that makes saying goodbye hard.

activities.name: Drive to Liberia Airport
activities.description: Allow 3 hours for the drive back to Liberia (LIR). The road out of Nosara is unpaved for the first 30 minutes and can be slow behind trucks. Stop in the town of Nicoya for a quick casado at a local soda if you're hungry. Drop your rentals, check in, and start the group chat about next year's trip.
tips: Leave Nosara by 10–11am for afternoon flights. The unpaved road is slower than you think, especially on weekends with more traffic. Don't cut it close.
